field_text_formatted.value: If an interceptor has side effects, such as logging, it can skip that dry run by checking config[Symbol.for('druxt.processCache.probe')]. If an interceptor only gets the token after an await, the cache still sees it only when the first response arrives, so set that token on the Axios defaults instead. @nuxtjs/auth-next already does this unless token.global is off. Menus work the same way, including when an interceptor adds credentials only to menu requests.
